source_title: India ‘Nation First, Always First’: Yogi Adityanath Calls On People To Join Run For Unity
source_excerpt:
Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Saturday paid tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel on his birth anniversary and extended greetings to people on the occasion of National Unity Day.
Remembering Patel, popularly known as the 'Iron Man of India' and the architect of modern India, Adityanath described the preservation of national unity as the duty of every Indian. He also highlighted Patel's contribution to the vision of 'Ek Bharat-Shreshtha Bharat'.
In a post on X, the Chief Minister said Patel's life conveyed the enduring message that a nation's strength lies in its unity, which is rooted in the spirit of 'Nation First'.
The Chief Minister alleged that before 2017, the spirit of national unity in Uttar Pradesh had been weakened by the politics of appeasement, casteism and dynasticism, affecting social harmony.
He credited Prime Minister Narendra Modi's guidance and the BJP's double-engine government with changing the situation.

Adityanath wrote: "Before 2017, the politics of appeasement, casteism and dynasticism in Uttar Pradesh had divided society, weakened the spirit of national unity and undermined social harmony. Under the able guidance of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the double-engine government transformed this situation. By placing the spirit of 'Nation First' and the mantra of 'Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, Sabka Vishwas' at the centre of governance, we strengthened social harmony and linked the invaluable legacy of revered Sardar Patel with the vision of 'Ek Bharat-Shreshtha Bharat'."
Adityanath also highlighted the 'Run for Unity', organised every year on Patel's birth anniversary, saying it offered an opportunity to reinforce the commitment to national unity.
The Chief Minister wrote: "The 'Run for Unity', organised on the birth anniversary of revered Sardar Patel and National Unity Day, provides a collective opportunity to embed this resolve in the consciousness and conduct of every citizen."
Calling upon people to participate in the event, he said every step should reflect their commitment to the country's integrity and the resolve of 'Nation First, Always First'.
He also paid his respects to Patel, describing him as a 'Bharat Ratna' and the 'Iron Man of India', whose life was dedicated to the service of the nation.

## राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस का आयोजन

उत्तर प्रदेश के मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ ने शनिवार को सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल की जयंती के अवसर पर उन्हें श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित की और राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस की शुभकामनाएं दीं। इस अवसर पर उन्होंने नागरिकों से 'रन फॉर Unity' में शामिल होने का आह्वान किया।

## सरदार पटेल के योगदान का स्मरण

मुख्यमंत्री ने सरदार पटेल को 'भारत रत्न', आधुनिक भारत का शिल्पी और 'लौह पुरुष' बताते हुए याद किया। उन्होंने कहा कि पटेल का जीवन यह संदेश देता है कि राष्ट्र की शक्ति उसकी एकता में निहित है, जो 'राष्ट्र प्रथम' की भावना से जुड़ी हुई है। उन्होंने 'एक भारत-श्रेष्ठ भारत' के विजन में पटेल के महत्वपूर्ण योगदान का भी उल्लेख किया।

## राजनीतिक आरोप और सरकार की उपलब्धियां

रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, मुख्यमंत्री ने आरोप लगाया कि वर्ष 2017 से पहले उत्तर प्रदेश में तुष्टीकरण, जातिवाद और परिवारवाद की राजनीति ने सामाजिक सौहार्द को प्रभावित किया था और राष्ट्रीय एकता को कमजोर किया था। उन्होंने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के मार्गदर्शन और डबल-इंजन सरकार को इस स्थिति में बदलाव लाने का श्रेय दिया।

* **एकता का संकल्प:** मुख्यमंत्री ने कहा कि हर वर्ष आयोजित होने वाली 'रन फॉर Unity' नागरिकों को देश की अखंडता और 'राष्ट्र प्रथम, हमेशा प्रथम' के संकल्प के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता मजबूत करने का अवसर देती है।
* **सत्यापन:** इस घोषणा और आधिकारिक बयानों के संबंध में अधिक जानकारी के लिए सरकार के आधिकारिक पोर्टल या संबंधित जनसंपर्क माध्यमों की सहायता ली जा सकती है।

en_body:
Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath appealed to citizens to participate in the annual 'Run for Unity' event held on the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, observed as National Unity Day. 

## Paying Tribute to the 'Iron Man of India'

On Saturday, Chief Minister Adityanath paid public tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, whom he referred to as the 'Iron Man of India', the architect of modern India, and a recipient of the Bharat Ratna. According to statements published on social media, Adityanath emphasized that preserving national unity remains a fundamental duty for every citizen and aligns with the vision of 'Ek Bharat-Shreshtha Bharat'.

* **Core Message:** Adityanath stated that Patel's life reflects the principle that national strength relies on unity founded on a 'Nation First' mindset.
* **Annual Event:** The 'Run for Unity' is organized yearly to offer a collective platform for reinforcing commitments to national integrity.

## Political Context and Governance Claims

In his remarks, the Chief Minister asserted that prior to 2017, Uttar Pradesh faced social challenges driven by casteism, dynasticism, and appeasement politics, which he claimed affected social harmony. He credited the current administration under Prime Minister Narendra Modi's guidance with improving the situation through governance focused on inclusion and the 'Nation First' principle.

## Practical Implications and Verification

* **Participation:** Citizens interested in local 'Run for Unity' events are encouraged to check official state government portals or district administration announcements for scheduling and venue details.
* **Information Verification:** Readers can verify official statements and event details by visiting the Uttar Pradesh government's official media handles or checking primary announcements published on the government's official communication channels.
